entry.title: MoonClaw remediation-margin refresh follow-up task for First Trusted Square / Shackleton Rim rehearsal tile
entry.summary: accepted follow-up task consumes NoConsumeRefreshSimulationBlocked from AllRefreshesStillBlocking with 3 blocking refreshes (refresh-terrain-northeast-stepout, refresh-illumination-northeast-stepout, refresh-energy-window) over margins (terrain-northeast-stepout, illumination-northeast-stepout, energy-window); simulation simulation-blocked, may consume false, hardware authority moonmoon-safety-gate-only at hardware-denied

followup_actions.reason: Re-run the terrain refresh first because moonrobo/first-trusted-square/remediation-margin-v1/refresh-projection still blocks simulation consumption on selected-route grade, roughness, and blocking-edge evidence.
Re-run the local-horizon refresh after terrain so illumination evidence remains tied to bounded terrain-shadow geometry for northeast-stepout.
Re-run bounded energy refresh last because demand and reserve evidence should consume the refreshed terrain and local-horizon constraints for northeast-stepout.
